title: Oxblood Manifesto — Saturated Truth Placard
description: A single statement detonates across a flat, saturated color field — no hierarchy, no imagery, no decoration. Modeled on Holzer truisms and Kruger plates, this template turns one sentence into an unavoidable physical fact.
philosophy: This template is built on the conviction that most slides lie through abundance: the subheading excuses the headline, the body copy hedges the subheading. Here there is only one idea and it occupies the entire room. It refuses gradients because gradients suggest ambiguity. It refuses images because images compete. It exists for the speaker whose single sentence IS the argument — and for the audience that needs to feel it before they can debate it.
goodFor: 3–7 word thesis reveals at the opening of a keynote
Advocacy and protest-style presentations where moral urgency is the message
Op-ed deck title slides that must anchor everything that follows
Panel or conference moments requiring a visual slap between content-heavy sections
avoidFor: Any slide requiring supporting context, footnotes, or sourced claims
Investor decks where credibility relies on visible data density
author: harness

examples.promptCore: A protest placard detonated at slide scale — a flat, fully saturated color field bears a single statement hammered across its surface with the weight of a physical object. The mood is confrontational stillness: no gradient softens the ground, no illustrative element competes, no decorative gesture dilutes the urgency. Compositional rhythm is a deliberate flood — dense at center, pressing toward every edge — referencing Holzer truisms and Kruger plates where the text IS the surface and the surface IS the argument. Avoid any visual device that implies footnote, context, or hedge.
examples.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="#a83232"/>
<g font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif" fill="#f5f0e6" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="-12">
<text x="960" y="340" font-size="300" textLength="1840" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">ABUNDANCE</text>
<text x="960" y="620" font-size="300" textLength="1500" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">IS HOW</text>
<text x="960" y="900" font-size="300" textLength="1820" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">SLIDES LIE.</text>
</g>
</svg>
examples.layoutNotes: Full canvas bleed — zero outer margin, no gutter, no header band, no footer zone. A single text block is centered on both axes and scaled to consume the overwhelming majority of the slide surface, leaving only minimal air at the four edges as visual pressure, not breathing room. No page number, no logo anchor, no rule lines or dividers exist anywhere on the canvas. Hierarchy is structurally abolished: one typographic element, one flat color plane, nothing else.

examples.promptCore: The slide IS the argument: one statement detonates across a flat, airless color field with nowhere to look but at it. Compositionally brutal — the text is not placed on the slide, it fills it, pressing against invisible edges like a word trying to escape. The secondary fragment below the rule functions as placard credit rather than caption — it whispers while the statement shouts. Avoid softness, gradients, timid centering, or any visual device that cushions the main claim's impact.
examples.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
  <rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="#a83232"/>

  <!-- Corner registration ticks (brutalist friction) -->
  <g fill="#0a0a0a">
    <rect x="40" y="40" width="36" height="2"/>
    <rect x="40" y="40" width="2" height="36"/>
    <rect x="1844" y="40" width="36" height="2"/>
    <rect x="1878" y="40" width="2" height="36"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top micro-label band -->
  <g font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" fill="#0a0a0a" font-size="18" font-weight="500">
    <text x="40" y="70" letter-spacing="3">MANIFESTO / 04 ─── ON CLARITY</text>
    <text x="1880" y="70" text-anchor="end" letter-spacing="3">FILE: OXBLOOD.04 · 2026·04·23</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Headline: floods the plane, line-height crushed, intentional clip -->
  <g font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif"
     fill="#0a0a0a"
     font-weight="900"
     font-size="280"
     letter-spacing="-14">
    <text x="40" y="380" textLength="1840" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">A SLIDE THAT</text>
    <text x="40" y="620" textLength="1840" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">EXPLAINS ITSELF</text>
    <text x="40" y="860" textLength="1840" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">IS APOLOGIZING.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Rotated black sticker crashing into the title -->
  <g transform="translate(1560 250) rotate(8)">
    <rect x="-150" y="-60" width="300" height="120" fill="#0a0a0a"/>
    <text x="0" y="-8" font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif"
          fill="#f5f0e6" font-size="28" font-weight="800"
          text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="2">NO FOOTNOTE.</text>
    <text x="0" y="34" font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif"
          fill="#a83232" font-size="28" font-weight="800"
          text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="2">NO HEDGE.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Knockout block punching through the third line -->
  <g>
    <rect x="40" y="780" width="540" height="100" fill="#f5f0e6"/>
    <text x="60" y="860" font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif"
          fill="#0a0a0a" font-weight="900" font-size="280"
          letter-spacing="-14" textLength="500" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">IS APO</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Full-width hairline rule above the placard credit -->
  <rect x="0" y="940" width="1920" height="2" fill="#0a0a0a"/>

  <!-- Placard credit / secondary fragment, bottom-left -->
  <g font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" fill="#0a0a0a">
    <text x="40" y="990" font-size="22" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="3">— SAID PLAINLY, BY THE AUTHOR, ONCE.</text>
    <text x="40" y="1030" font-size="16" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="2" fill="#3a3a3a">THESIS 04 OF 11  ·  OXBLOOD MANIFESTO  ·  READ ALOUD BEFORE PRINTING</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom-right counter -->
  <g font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" fill="#0a0a0a" font-weight="700">
    <text x="1880" y="1030" font-size="22" text-anchor="end" letter-spacing="3">04 / 11</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Vertical tick rail on right margin -->
  <g stroke="#0a0a0a" stroke-width="2">
    <line x1="1900" y1="120" x2="1900" y2="900"/>
    <line x1="1890" y1="120" x2="1910" y2="120"/>
    <line x1="1890" y1="510" x2="1910" y2="510"/>
    <line x1="1890" y1="900" x2="1910" y2="900"/>
  </g>
</svg>
examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed saturated field, edge-to-edge with no outer margin — content occupies the entire plane. Primary statement text spans all 12 columns of a 12-col grid across 2–4 lines at flood scale, vertically centered with a slight upward bias so the weight reads as intentional, not accidental. A single secondary fragment — attribution, counter, or one-word qualifier — anchors bottom-left, separated from the statement block by a single full-width hairline rule. No header band, no page number, no unused negative space.
